bandReport.notes: Band covers items 23-43 across pages 6-9, contiguous with no skipped number. BOUNDARIES: page 6 opens with Q23 fresh at the top of column 1, so nothing of it lies on page 5 (that page belongs to another band). Page 9 ends with Q43 whole — its stem and all four options sit in column 2 of page 9 — so nothing of my band continues onto page 10. Q44 begins on page 10 and is another band's. CROPS: no sliced crop on any of the four pages. Every c1 carries a thin vertical sliver of the right column's bold item numbers (e.g. 25./26./27. down the right edge of p06-c1) and every c2 begins with the leftmost digit of its first item number slightly shaved (e.g. '25.' on p06-c2, '40.' on p09-c2); both are the expected gutter overlap, every number was confirmed against the corresponding pNN.png, and no text was lost. Gutter x sat at 915/909/907/905 px on pages 6/7/8/9 — stable across the band. PRINTED ODDITIES, all transcribed verbatim and none corrected: Q31 sets the word 'not' in bold italic for emphasis ('which of the following statements is not correct ?') — transcribed as plain text since the JSON carries no formatting; Q37 prints the town as 'Mazar-i-sharif' with a lowercase 's' in 'sharif'; Q43 prints 'Defense' with the American spelling inside the proper name 'Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD)' while option (d) of the same item uses British 'defence'; Q33's opening quotation mark before 'International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA)' is set as a right single quote rather than a left one in the scan. No question in this band has duplicate option texts, a missing option, or fewer/more than four options. Q37 is the band's only printed grid (a two-column pairs table) and is rendered as a GFM pipe table with its separator row.
